讬.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 乇 represents the sound.

㐬.o: Depicts an upside-down child (𠫓) being born with amniotic fluid (川) coming out.

丬.o: 丬 is a component form of 爿.

卬.o: Depicts a person kneeling (卩) looking up to a person standing (人).

夬.o: Depicts a hand (又) wearing a thumb ring. Thumb rings are typically used for archery to protect the archer's thumb when pulling back on the bowstring. Based on the original meaning "thumb ring". The meaning later shifted to "parted".

灬.o: 灬 is a component form of 火, which is a pictograph of fire.

c.g: traditional Chinese unit of length ~ 1 foot
to roll rice into a ball
